captions_note: built with CAPTIONS=0, so the reel's own captions stay on in the caption style the buyer picked, in the band this layout leaves on the speaker's chest: build.py prints the fx_add.py --caption-y value to use
in_a_reel: build with CAPTIONS=0 and add the slot with the --caption-y value build.py prints: the buyer's captions sit in the caption band of the window. Look at one reel snapshot inside the slot; a tall caption style needs fewer card rows
set F_IN to 9 or later and F_OUT before the slot ends, so the slot starts and ends on the plain picture. F_OUT = None only when the slot ends on a cut or at the end of the reel
leave the GRADE switch off (the reel owns the look)
ACCENT is the buyer's brand colour or the reel's accent colour
steps: do get the figures from the buyer: every title, label, value and unit in CARDS comes from what is said in the clip or from figures the buyer gives. Never invent, estimate or round up a number, a name, a tool or a ranking. No figures from the buyer = no Stack: leave it out and say so
run onsets.py      # 1. word onsets as frames -> F_IN, F_OUT, at, win_at, CAPS in build.py
run measure.py      # 2. head from the cutout alpha -> work/head.json; LOOK at work/head.jpg
run build.py SAFE=1 CAPTIONS=0      # 3. page with the safe guide; read what it prints
run build.py CAPTIONS=0      # 4. clean page (no guide), then render
